subject: PLAN2.P5.4

cases.assertions: Lost owner reply + independent Run/Action/stream cancellation; no fabricated rollback; same-key late reconciliation.
Completed owner effect survives TTS stop; partial delivery evidence is independent and replayed.
Independent cancellation commands and terminal Run policy; explicit compensation also required by cancel.explicit-compensation.
Unknown acknowledgement remains null, generated units are not delivered units, wrong output binding/fence denied.
Injected late local effect receipt failure after partial stream interruption; reconciliation/partial receipt survive with one owner write.
Manual effect result and operator receipt roll back together on deferred SQL failure, then recover.
Stale version, wrong same-epoch target, forged owner receipt and revoked operator denied; successful reason/evidence audited once.
Current authority, tenant, version/epoch and append-only audit/terminal decision guards.
Source closure leaves cancelling and unknown effects visible.
Separate registered Action, new key, fresh consent/confirmation and explicit owner execution; original history preserved.
Unknown original, denied operator, missing fresh proof and revoked owner cannot execute compensation; input traces redacted.
Actual SIGKILL after durable cancellation/audit commit and before response; restart returns original receipt.
Two PHP processes overlap on PostgreSQL locks and commit one cancellation/receipt.

limitations: Synthetic transport acknowledgements and owner/operator authority fixtures; no real stream/TTS provider qualification.
Accounting owners remain external; no automatic release, recharge or compensation.
